featured_reviews.name: Aamna Quraishii
featured_reviews.review_text:
Got their croissants and chocolate eclairs for some weekend indulgence, and what a pleasantly unexpected surprise this has been!
The butter croissant is flaky, buttery deliciousness. The chocolate croissant is all that plus the most scrumptious, mouth watering chocolate filling!

Don’t be fooled by soft, bready looking packs in store. Take them home and warm in a hot oven for 2-3 mins; leave to cool and they will be the best croissants you will have bought at a bakery in the city. Crispy on the outside with those layers and a good bite inside!

The eclair was polished off with no time for a photo but again, delicious chocolate coating and cream filling, soft base which can be warmed and crisped on a pan if you like it toasted.

Portions are massive and well priced.

I bought the croissants end of day on a Friday and they tasted fresh through the weekend stored at room temp; eclair in the fridge.

Quick billing at the late hour but they do get very busy during peak.
Their cookies and palmiers are legendary; looking forward to trying other pastries and tiramisu soon!

customer_updates.text:
Review: Brunch & Cake, Mumbai

Brunch & Cake, the globally renowned café chain originating from Barcelona, has finally made its way to Mumbai, much to the delight of food lovers. Known for its Instagram-worthy aesthetics and delectable menu, the franchise has built a stellar reputation across the world, with branches in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Saudi Arabia. Now, the Mumbai outpost brings its signature charm and culinary excellence to India's bustling food scene.

Located in worli , the café boasts chic interiors that strike a perfect balance between contemporary elegance and cozy charm. With pastel hues, warm wooden accents, and lush greenery adorning the space, Brunch & Cake offers a serene ambiance that feels like a slice of Europe. The thoughtful layout, natural lighting, and beautifully plated dishes make it an ideal spot for both casual diners and social media enthusiasts.

The avocado toast is a masterpiece of both taste and presentation, offering a delightful combination of fresh, creamy avocado, artisanal bread, and vibrant toppings that elevate the dish. Pair it with their signature milk cake dessert, a rich, indulgent treat that perfectly rounds off the experience. Brunch & Cake has managed to set the bar high in Mumbai, staying true to its reputation as a global favorite.

The food was equally impressive—the avocado toast was fresh, creamy, and full of flavor with a great mix of textures, while the chicken alfredo was rich, comforting, and perfectly done with tender chicken and a delicious creamy sauce. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented. What added even more to the experience was the hospitality—the staff were warm, attentive, and quick to help without being intrusive. # **A Symphony of Flavor: Daily Bread's Hot Cross Buns**
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
**"A Taste of Tradition, Wrapped in Delight"**
**Introduction:**
In the heart of Maundy Thursday, as the world prepares for Easter, I embarked on a delightful journey with Daily Bread's Hot Cross Buns. These golden orbs, adorned with their signature cross, promised more than just sustenance—they whispered stories of tradition, warmth, and the joy of shared moments.
**Appearance:**
The buns arrived like miniature suns, their golden crusts glistening under the morning light. The cross etched into each bun stood proud, a symbol of faith and unity. As I unwrapped them, the aroma of cinnamon and nutmeg danced around me, inviting me to partake in this sacred treat.
**Texture and Taste:**
With a gentle tear, the buns revealed their tender crumb. Soft, yet resilient, they yielded to my touch. Each bite was a revelation—a symphony of flavors. The spices played their part: cinnamon hummed, nutmeg chimed, and the faint zest of orange lingered. The currants, plump and sweet, added a delightful surprise. And oh, that cross! It was more than mere decoration; it held the promise of resurrection.
**Packaging:**
The packaging was more than practical—it was an invitation to slow down, savor, and appreciate life's simple pleasures. A nod to tradition, a whisper of love.
**Conclusion:**
As I savored the last crumbs, I realized that Daily Bread's Hot Cross Buns were more than a pastry; they were a connection to centuries past. They carried the warmth of family gatherings, the sweetness of shared laughter, and the hope of renewal. So, here's to Daily Bread N Foods—for crafting not just buns, but memories.
*Unique, vibrant, and utterly delightful—these buns are a testament to the magic of tradition.*

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Wadke
featured_reviews.review_text:
Let's start with the positives :
1. Food packed and presented nicely.
2. Quantity of food is good.
3. Food quality is good.

Dishes :
1. Chicken Kheema Pattice : Honestly, one of the best I have had. Must try.
2. Chicken Berry Pulao with Dhansak : I usually don't like dhansak, but this was an exception. The dhansak was good, the kebabs were as authentic parsi as they get and the pulao was lovely too.
3. Chicken Salli boti: The sauce was absolutely spot on tangy, sweet, spicy. The chicken pieces though were dry. Also, I don't know if they forgot or they don't serve it, but there was no salli!
4. Atheli Murgi: Major disappointment.. they served something like a heavy gravy version of sweet Butter Chicken.
5. Chicken Kheema par Eedu: This was nice, layered pao, kheema and egg..
6. Lagan nu custard : Nice, but I missed the browning of the crust on top. Flavours spot on.
7. Bread pudding : Nice.

Anyways apart from the Atheli murgi, all  flavours were basically spot on. Also, they surely didn't cheap out on ingredients,  quantity or packaging (unlike so many other establishments today). And they paid attention to the small things, like the cute small paos, the little onion, tomatoes kachumber etc..

featured_reviews.name: nisha suvarna
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had visited HomeChef once before and really liked the food from their regular menu. However, our experience at their Mexican fest yesterday was completely different.

We ordered the chicken enchilada, chicken soft tacos, and guacamole with chips. The soft chicken tacos were poorly executed—drenched in heavy, overpowering sauces that masked all other flavors. There seemed to be an odd mix of something like ketchup along with a thick, creamy sauce, topped with a bit of shredded cabbage. The chicken itself was overly saucy, making the tacos soggy and messy instead of fresh and flavorful.

The enchiladas had a very similar filling and suffered from the same problem—too much sauce, no balance, and no distinct or authentic taste.

When you order Mexican food, you expect fresh elements like salsa, jalapeños, onions, and a good balance of textures and seasoning. Unfortunately, none of that came through here, making the dishes feel inauthentic and poorly put together.

To make matters worse, both of us ended up with an upset stomach. Overall, it was a very disappointing experience - not worth it at all.

Although the enchilada was removed from the bill after we shared our feedback, the overall experience is what stays with you.

featured_reviews.name: Zaina
featured_reviews.review_text:
The ambiance is cozy with beautifully displayed desserts that instantly catch your eye and make the place feel warm and inviting.

"Desserts are the real heroes here".
The Sebastian Cake is a must-try and the custard Bombolini is dangerously good.
Cakes, pastries and cookies are all fresh and worth picking up for takeaway.
The staff are polite and always happy to help. The only downside is the service coordination. One person takes the order, another asks what you ordered, someone else brings the food and a different person arrives with the bill. By the end you're not sure who your server actually is. 😅 Better coordination would make the experience much smoother.

Food Ratings:
•Sebastian Cake – 5/5
•French Vanilla Bombolini – 5/5
•Cookies – 4/5
•Pastries & Cakes – 4/5
•Chicken nuggets - 4/5
•Veg Russian Sandwich - 4/5
•Pani Puri – 3/5
•Sev Puri – 2/5
•Italian Pizza – 1/5
•French Fries - 1/5
The French fries were excessively crisp and hard to the point where they became uncomfortable to eat after a few bites. A slightly lighter fry would improve them considerably.

Bottom Line : Come for the desserts, stay for the desserts and probably order more desserts.
The bakery section shines far brighter than the savoury menu.

featured_reviews.name: Bilal Tajak
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today, we went to Deliure around 8:00 PM and placed our order. The staff told us it would take 40–45 minutes. Despite the long delay, we waited patiently as we are regular customers. While we were sitting inside, a major parking issue was unfolding outside. It was entirely Deliure’s fault because they failed to arrange proper parking management, which caused a lot of trouble for the locals and led to a massive traffic jam. Consequently, people complained to the police. The local police and traffic police arrived at the scene and took two of Deliure's managers to the police station.
When we finally walked outside, we found that our vehicle had been fined. This happened even though we had parked our vehicle exactly where the Deliure staff had instructed us to. When we went back inside to confront the Deliure management about this, they bluntly told us that they were not responsible for the fine, and their behaviour towards us was extremely rude.
They could have easily informed us about the ongoing parking issue with the police while we were waiting inside for our order, and they could have asked us to move our vehicle. However, they chose not to do so, and because of their negligence, we ended up with a fine. Do we really deserve this treatment? We waited so long for our food, and in return, we had to pay a fine! Is this how they respect their regular customers?
Furthermore, this entire parking chaos and heavy order load escalated because Deliure was prioritizing online orders over offline walk-in customers. Their mentality is crystal clear—they only care about making money from online orders, making offline customers wait indefinitely, and leaving them in deep trouble when their vehicles get fined due to the establishment's mismanagement.
